claims.claim_text: The official Army-entry record is confirmed as the Daniel Bender listed in the OSS personnel index.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official files share the exact name, exact private identifier, and compatible enlisted status.
claims.identity_match_assessment: A unique private identifier is decisive; the matching name and enlisted grade provide additional corroboration.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record dates entry to January 19, 1942; it does not establish the date or route into OSS.
claims.match_notes: The identifier is retained privately and masked publicly.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry on January 19, 1942, Daniel Bender was classified as a retail manager.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact-matched Army record carries code 072, which NARA's corrected list defines as retail managers.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier confirms that the coded Army record belongs to this indexed person.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded to Army entry, but not proven to identify the immediate pre-OSS role or a named civilian employer.
claims.match_notes: No company, store, product line, or self-employment status is inferred.
